Title: General availability: Time travel in Azure Synapse Link for Azure Cosmos DB

Body.Content:
Time travel enables you to access Azure Cosmos DB data in the analytical store, precisely as it appeared at specific points in time in history (down to the millisecond level). 

Learn more.
